name: ElevenLabsMusic
title: ElevenLabs Music
description: Compose a music track from a text prompt. Outputs base64 MP3.
whenToUse: Compose MUSIC from a description: a backing track, a theme, a loop, a score for a video. It writes and performs a piece from words, so it is for music rather than for a one-off sound effect or for reading text aloud.

package.name: elevenlabs
package.packageFile:
$schema: ../_schema/package.schema.json

# ELEVENLABS, fully declarative — all five nodes.
#
# ALL FIVE, not four, and that is forced rather than ambitious: they share ONE credential, and
# declaration is all-or-nothing per package (`registerCredentialType` is first-wins and silent, so a
# credentials/*.yaml alongside a live registerCredential() means one of them vanishes at random). So
# SpeechToText could not be left behind — which is why `encoding: multipart` was built first.
#
# FOUR SHAPES, ONE PACKAGE:
#   TTS, Dialogue, Music, SoundEffects   POST JSON, receive raw audio bytes → transport: binary
#   SpeechToText                         POST a FORM carrying the audio file → encoding: multipart
#
# ONE PATH DROPPED, deliberately, and it is worth reading before assuming it was an oversight. The TTS
# node also carried a MULTI-SPEAKER COMPAT path: it sniffed [DETECTIVE]: labels out of the text, mapped
# them to hardcoded voice pools, tried /text-to-dialogue, and on failure fell back to one TTS call per
# segment with the mp3 buffers CONCATENATED. That concatenation is byte work no manifest can describe.
#
# It is gone because its reason is gone. The path existed to preserve the MurderMystery app, which is now
# in _legacy/; `characterId` and `characterGender` appear nowhere in apps/ outside the node's own files;
# and the service's own header already said "for general multi-speaker work prefer the dedicated
# ElevenLabs Dialogue node", which is in this package and takes explicit per-line voices. So the
# capability is not lost, it moved to the node built for it.

name: elevenlabs
displayName: ElevenLabs
description: Speech, dialogue, music and sound effects from ElevenLabs
version: 2.0.0
category: media
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1768540562/gravity/icons/elevanlabs.jpg

features:
  - Text to speech, dialogue, music and sound effects
  - Transcription with word-level timings

allowedHosts:
  - api.elevenlabs.io

requires:
  executorVersion: ">=1.6.0"
  credential: [apiKeyHeader]
  # `binary` for the four generators, `json` for transcription's reply.
  transport: [binary, json]
  encoding: [multipart]

credentials.elevenlabsCredential.yaml:
$schema: ../../_schema/credential.schema.json

# The TYPE NAME is kept exactly as it was when these nodes lived in `ingest`, so credentials already
# stored against it keep resolving. A credential is selected by type name, so renaming it would leave
# every existing workflow authenticating with nothing.
name: elevenlabsCredential
displayName: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs API credentials for text-to-speech, sound effects, and transcription

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your ElevenLabs API key from the dashboard (Profile then API Keys)
    placeholder: Enter your ElevenLabs API key

shared.audio.yaml:
# THE AUDIO OUTPUT, shared by the four generators.
#
# `response` is the BINARY reply handed over as { base64, contentType } — what `transport: binary`
# produces, and the same shape a `multipart` file part consumes, so bytes have ONE representation
# everywhere they travel in this platform.
#
# Shared because four nodes emit the identical object and a fifth will: the day the shape changes, it
# changes once.

out: >-
  return { data: response.base64, mimeType: response.contentType || 'audio/mpeg', fileName: 'audio.mp3' }
shared.credential.yaml:
# ElevenLabs authenticates with `xi-api-key`, on every call in the package.
#
# Shared because repeating it five times is five chances to mistype the header name, and a wrong header
# is a 401 that reads like a bad key rather than a bad manifest.

scheme: apiKeyHeader
header: xi-api-key
value: "{{ credentials.elevenlabsCredential.apiKey }}"

files.api/events.yaml:
- emit: audio
  value: { $ref: audio#out }

- emit: metadata
  value: "return { format: 'mp3', lengthSeconds: config.lengthSeconds, prompt: config.prompt }"
files.api/run.yaml:
# ONE POST returning RAW AUDIO, like the other three generators.
#
# THE LENGTH IS IN MILLISECONDS on the wire while the field is in SECONDS, which is the vendor's unit and
# a trap worth naming: passing seconds straight through asks for a three-second track and gets one.
# Clamped to the endpoint's 10–300s window, transcribed from the service, and ROUNDED because a
# fractional millisecond is rejected.

- name: compose
  method: POST
  url: https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/music
  credential: { $ref: credential }

  body:
    prompt: "{{ config.prompt }}"
    model_id: "{{ config.modelId }}"
    music_length_ms: >-
      return typeof config.lengthSeconds === 'number'
        ? Math.round(Math.max(10, Math.min(300, config.lengthSeconds)) * 1000) : undefined
    force_instrumental: "return config.forceInstrumental ? true : undefined"

  query:
    # A QUERY param on /v1/music, not a body field — the service says so explicitly.
    output_format: "{{ config.outputFormat }}"

  # Longer than the others: composing a few minutes of music takes far more than a sound effect.
  timeoutMs: 300000
  transport: binary
files.config.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/config.schema.json

configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [prompt]
  properties:
    prompt:
      type: string
      title: Prompt
      description: Describe the music, e.g. "slow cinematic piano with strings, hopeful, building".
      default: "{{{input}}}"
      "ui:field": template
    lengthSeconds:
      type: number
      title: Length (seconds)
      description: 10 to 300. Leave blank to let the model choose.
      minimum: 10
      maximum: 300
    modelId:
      type: string
      title: Model
      description: Override the music model. Leave blank for the package default.
      default: ""
    forceInstrumental:
      type: boolean
      title: Instrumental Only
      description: Compose without vocals
      default: false
      "ui:widget": toggle
    outputFormat:
      type: string
      title: Output Format
      description: Audio encoding, e.g. mp3_44100_128. Leave blank for the account default.
      default: ""

    # WHO MAY RUN THIS BOX, set by whoever builds the workflow (15-who-can-run-it.md).
    #
    # INSTANCE config, not the manifest's `auth`, and the two answer different questions.
    # The manifest is the node author's FLOOR: "this node is inherently privileged". These
    # are the builder's, per box on the canvas, because the same node type legitimately
    # faces staff on one workflow and customers on another.
    #
    # A role especially has to live here: `finance:approve` is a claim THIS deployment's
    # identity provider mints, and a node published to the marketplace cannot know the role
    # vocabulary of every universe that installs it.
    #
    # The executor takes the STRICTER of the two. Neither can loosen the other.
    authRequired:
      type: boolean
      title: Require sign-in
      description: Only signed-in callers can run this step.
      default: false
      "ui:widget": toggle
    authRole:
      type: string
      title: Require role
      description: A claim the caller must carry, like finance:approve.
      default: ""
      "ui:dependencies": { authRequired: true }

"ui:order":
  [authRequired, authRole, prompt, lengthSeconds, forceInstrumental, modelId, outputFormat]
files.interface.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/interface.schema.json

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Text prompt describing the music to compose

outputs:
  - name: audio
    type: object
    description: "Generated audio: { data (base64), mimeType, fileName }"
  - name: metadata
    type: object
    description: format, lengthSeconds, prompt

credentials:
  - name: elevenlabsCredential
    required: true
files.node.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/node.schema.json

type: ElevenLabsMusic
kind: PromiseNode

name: ElevenLabs Music
category: Media & Design
color: "#FF69B4"
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1768540562/gravity/icons/elevanlabs.jpg

description: Compose a music track from a text prompt. Outputs base64 MP3.

whenToUse: >-
  Compose MUSIC from a description: a backing track, a theme, a loop, a score for a video. It writes and
  performs a piece from words, so it is for music rather than for a one-off sound effect or for reading
  text aloud.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (DECLARATIVE_NODES.md §9.13). Compulsory on every node, so that a node
# nobody thought about cannot look the same as one deliberately left open.
#
# `required: false` adds no requirement of its own: the node runs for whoever the trigger
# admitted. The trigger instance's publicEntry toggle still owns the door, and requirements
# only ever narrow.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  cacheable: false
files.test.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/test.schema.json

# Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. The shortest allowed length is used deliberately: this spends credits and
# composes in real time, so a 300-second fixture would be a slow test and an expensive one.

testData:
  config:
    prompt: slow cinematic piano with strings, hopeful, building
    lengthSeconds: 10
    forceInstrumental: true
  inputs:
    input: slow cinematic piano with strings, hopeful, building
  expect:
    audio: >-
      return typeof output.audio.data === 'string'
        && output.audio.data.length > 1000
        && output.audio.mimeType.startsWith('audio/')
    metadata: "return output.metadata.lengthSeconds === 10"
